parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the user label. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Settings: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The collection of user label IDs.
